summary: Frontend-only verification of the new seeded non-admin demo login plus admin login regression on the public preview URL. Demo (demo@neksathi.app/demo1234) logs in via /login and lands on /dashboard ('Hi Demo, your garage'), nav-admin is absent, and direct navigation to /admin correctly redirects back to /dashboard. Admin (admin@safeqr.com/admin1234) logs in, lands on /dashboard and nav-admin IS visible. Logout via nav-account-btn -> logout-btn works (redirects, nav-login reappears). Invalid password shows login-error 'Incorrect email or password'. No console errors. Backend testing skipped per request; auth code reviewed against the playbook checklist.

minor.issue: allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec (browsers reject credentialed wildcard). Playbook requires explicit origins.
No brute-force lockout after N failed attempts; only a 10/minute rate limit. Playbook expects lockout after 5 failures.
Token returned in JSON body (client stores it) instead of httpOnly cookie — deviates from playbook cookie guidance. App-wide design decision, not a functional break.

Admin and demo seeds only insert when missing; if ADMIN_PASSWORD/DEMO_PASSWORD env changes, the existing user's password_hash is NOT updated (playbook expects seed_admin to update password). Admin seed does lift is_admin, demo seed has no such reconciliation.

action_items: Replace CORS allow_origins=['*'] with explicit origins since allow_credentials=True.
Consider updating password_hash in the admin/demo seed when the env password differs (idempotent reconcile).
Optional: add failed-login lockout (5 attempts) as per auth playbook.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~7080 lines — should be split into routers/modules (>700 line guideline).
bcrypt hashing verified correct (gensalt rounds=12 -> $2b$ prefix).
seed_data_creation: None; used auto-seeded demo and admin accounts.
test_credentials: demo@neksathi.app / demo1234 (non-admin, verified), admin@safeqr.com / admin1234 (admin, verified)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testids: login-email, login-password, login-submit, login-error. Nav: nav-admin (admin only), nav-account-btn -> logout-btn for logout. Demo user has no vehicles/data. /admin route guard redirects non-admins to /dashboard.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — the demo-login feature works end to end in the UI.
